items.title: How to Test LLMs and AI Agents
items.snippet: LLM testing checks whether an AI-powered application or agent behaves as intended. That includes checking an agent's output, tool calls, state it updates, and whether it completes the user's task. Testing AI applications and agents combines code checks, evals, and human review to ensure any changes are safe to release.

items.title: Design Tenets for Agent Identity Management Systems
items.snippet: Agentic infrastructure enables the unique, cryptographically verifiable identification of agents distinguishable from other identities. This document outlines critical design principles for creating secure and auditable identity management systems for AI agents, promoting traceability and preventing misuse.

items.title: AI agent frameworks compared: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and more
items.snippet: A framework that works well for a short tool-calling loop may be a poor fit for a workflow that must pause for approval, survive process restarts, or coordinate several agents over multiple hours. This comparison delves into various AI agent frameworks, analyzing their strengths and weaknesses across different orchestration patterns and use cases.

items.title: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 is now available on Google Cloud
items.snippet: Gemini Robotics ER 2 transforms a robot into a physical agent. The model combines deep spatio-temporal reasoning and long-horizon planning, enabling robots to orchestrate steps to complete a task, self-correct, and generalize to novel situations. It combines advanced spatial and temporal video understanding with long-horizon planning and built-in safety guardrails.

dropped.title: Persistence is Futile. Or not? What's the Value of Persisting Digital Thread Relationships in an Mean-Oriented World?
dropped.snippet: AI's rapidly advancing ability to infer relationships across disparate structured data stores raises a valid question: do we still need to proactively rearchitect structured data to get the benefits of a digital thread, or can AI just infer that structure on the fly? Digital thread strategies need to find a balance between persisting structure and leveraging the power of AI inference.
